scope: Every explanation group with an LRS endpoint in the effective connection inventory, including cross-course and repeated edge instances.
method: Read all 609 distinct explanation strings with every endpoint pair and edge ID in bounded packs. Screen for inaccurate holdings, opinion attribution, chronology, procedural posture, overbreadth, and missing material limits. Recompare selected concerns against current canonical brief passages and primary judicial texts. Most other explanations did not receive a new sentence-by-sentence comparison to every underlying opinion. A no-correction screening result is not a citator check or certification of current law.

input.effectiveBasis: connection_inventory.py groups effective graph prose after runtime overlays; immutable seed text alone was not used.

readingBatchNote: Overlapping small batches re-read portions obscured by output truncation; all local indices 0–608 were read.
